newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury volume hits new volume record -GovPX.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury volume hits new volume record -GovPX.

text.p: Trading volume in the U.S. Treasury market surged to its highest level ever on Wednesday, according to GovPX.
Nearly $139 billion was traded during the session. By 1500 EST/2000 GMT, volume was at $125.3 billion, eclipsing the old record of $123.5 billion set on February 28. 1996, GovPX said.
The firm said volume was about 50 percent above an average Wednesday in the first quarter of 1996. Bill volume was some 68 percent higher, while coupon volume was up 35 percent.
Trading was heaviest in the two-year note, at $9.3 billion, followed by the when-issued year-bill, at $8.9 billion.
At the longer end, the long bond garnered $1.38 billion.
GovPX, which tracks trading volume, accounts for about two-thirds of total market volume, representing five of the six interdealer brokers.
